exposure: Levels of haptoglobin in cervicovaginal fluid (CVF)
Levels of matrix metalloproteinase (MMP)-8 in CVF
Levels of S100 calcium-binding protein A8 in CVF
Levels of serpin A1 in CVF
cohort: The cohort consisted of 134 consecutive singleton pregnant women experiencing preterm labor between 23+0 and 34+0 weeks of gestation who delivered preterm, and whose cervicovaginal fluid samples were collected at admission.
finding: Elevated levels of specific inflammatory proteins (haptoglobin, interleukin-6/8, kallistatin, MMP-8, and resistin) in cervicovaginal fluid were identified as potential biomarkers predictive of acute histologic chorioamnionitis and funisitis in women with preterm labor.
gest_age: Participants were between 23+0 and 34+0 weeks of gestation at the time of preterm labor, delivering preterm (before 37 weeks).
